meta.description: Machine-readable mirror of the Maplewood token contract in src/styles/global.css. Agents read this as the source of truth for which semantic tokens exist and where to use them. VALUES here are the neutral BASE values — each theme branch (Hearth, Beacon, Jubilee, Grove, Atelier) overwrites the values in global.css AND this file, but never the token NAMES, component APIs, or content.
meta.themingRule: A theme = (1) token values + (2) the font <link> in Head.astro + (3) per-component presentation. Components reference only these semantic tokens for color/font/radius/shadow/type — never hard-coded hex or px.

colors.note: Base is a clean TRUE-neutral grayscale (equal RGB channels) — not a warm-tinted near-white. Contrast is tuned so ink-soft and accent read at AA on the base before any theme tints them (ink-soft #565656 = 7.0:1 on bg, accent #585858 = 7.0:1). Warmth/identity is the theme branches' job, carried by accent + fonts + imagery.
colors.tailwindUtilities: Each token also yields utilities, e.g. bg-bg, bg-surface, text-ink, text-ink-soft, bg-primary, border-line.

fonts.display: system-ui stack (base) — swapped per theme via Head.astro
fonts.body: system-ui stack (base) — swapped per theme via Head.astro

scale.note: Fluid clamp scale in :root, ~1.28 ratio (confident, non-flat hierarchy). Themes may tune the clamps but keep the names. Used via var(--step-N) or arbitrary values.

headingDefaults.letterSpacing: -0.02em base; tightens with size (h1 -0.035em, h2 -0.03em, h3 -0.015em)
headingDefaults.note: Single neutral system family on the base — hierarchy is carried by size + weight + tracking contrast (brand.md: a single committed family beats a timid display+body pair). Theme branches repoint --font-display/--font-body to introduce a display face.

motion.revealVariants: .reveal (default rise), .reveal-soft (shorter travel for dense grids), .reveal-media (settle + scale for framed media). All honor prefers-reduced-motion.

outliers.outline: 1px solid var(--color-line) — repointed by hairline/outline themes (Atelier, Jubilee)
outliers.pop: var(--shadow) — repointed to a hard offset 'sticker' shadow by Jubilee

sharedClasses.eyebrow: uppercase tracked label with leading rule, colored by accent
sharedClasses.accent: emphasis word inside a headline (per-theme seam: italic/highlight/color)
sharedClasses.ph / ph-blob: image placeholder stand-in (swap to astro:assets <Image> in production)
sharedClasses.card: raised surface with hairline + soft shadow

hero.description: Two-column hero: eyebrow + headline (with accent word) + lead + dual CTA, paired with a 4:5 image placeholder + floating stat badge.

program-card.description: Home preview card: square image + age label + title + blurb.

program-row.description: Programs page: alternating image + copy + 3 meta stats, hairline-divided.

feature-grid.description: 2x2 icon + title + body cards on a sunk panel.

schedule.description: Vertical timeline of day waypoints (time + title + body).

testimonials.description: 3 quote cards on a dark band.

cta-band.description: Closing call-to-action box with heading, body, primary button.
